name: Nagaoka Seigo
source:
He is a serious, likeable young man, Chitose's husband and Youko's most loyal subordinate.

He respects Youko, and even shows that respect to the main character.

He is the epitome of solidity, sincerity, and honesty, but because of this, he is not able to satisfy his wife Chitose.
